name: TRN_DATCOC_Ins
definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[TRN_DATCOC_Ins]
@p_CustID varchar(15)=NULL,
@p_TienCoc varchar(100)=NULL,
@p_EmpID varchar(15)=NULL,
@p_CreatedBy varchar(15)=NULL,
@p_ShopID varchar(100)=NULL,
@p_Description nvarchar (500) = NULL,

@p_XML XML

AS
	DECLARE @m_TrnID varchar(15)
	DECLARE @p_Message nvarchar(max)
	DECLARE @MaTienTeHeThong Varchar(10)
	DECLARE @sBillCode nvarchar(20)
    DECLARE @p_ErrorCode1 nvarchar(max)
	SET @p_ErrorCode1 = ''
    SELECT @MaTienTeHeThong = ParaValue From SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'MaTienTeHeThong'
	SET @p_Message = ''
	
	DECLARE @sUP VARCHAR(3)
	SELECT @sUP=sp.ParaValue FROM SYS_PARAMETERS sp WHERE sp.ParaKey='UnitWeight'
	
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	DECLARE @sHeso NUMERIC(19,8) 
		
	SET @sHeso=dbo.fun_GetHS()

	DECLARE @sShopCode varchar(max)
	select @sShopCode = ISNULL(ShopCode,'') From T_Shop Where ShopID = @p_ShopID

	EXEC SYS_CodeMasters_Gen 'TRN_DATCOC' ,@m_TrnID OUTPUT
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	EXEC SYS_BILL_COUNTER_Gen 'TDC', @sShopCode, @sBillCode OUTPUT
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	declare @p_TrnDateTime_Upd datetime
	set @p_TrnDateTime_Upd = getdate()

BEGIN TRANSACTION
	INSERT INTO [TRN_DATCOC]([TrnID]
           ,[BillCode]
           ,[TrnDate]
           ,[TrnTime]
           ,[CustID]
           ,[TienCoc]
           ,[EmpID]
           ,[Description]
		   ,[CardPay]
		   ,[CashPay]
           ,[Status]
           ,[ShopID]
           ,[CreatedBy]
           ,[TrnDateTime_Upd]
           ,[UserID_Upd])
     VALUES
           (@m_TrnID
		   ,@sBillCode
           ,convert(datetime, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),@p_TrnDateTime_Upd,103) , 103)
           ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),@p_TrnDateTime_Upd,108)
           ,@p_CustID
           ,@p_TienCoc
           ,@p_EmpID
           ,@p_Description
		   ,0
		   ,0
           ,'W'
           ,@p_ShopID
		   ,@p_CreatedBy
		   ,@p_TrnDateTime_Upd
		   ,@p_CreatedBy)
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	--=========================================================================================================================================================
	DECLARE @TRN_DATCOC_DT TABLE(
	[ProductDesc] [nvarchar](500) NULL,
	[GoldCode] [varchar](10) NULL,
	[TotalWeight] [numeric](19, 8) NULL,
	[DiamondWeight] [numeric](19, 8) NULL,
	[GoldWeight] [numeric](19, 8) NULL,
	[TaskPrice] [numeric](18, 3) NULL,
	[Size] [NVARCHAR](MAX) NULL,
	[SL] [INT] NULL,
	[Notes] [nvarchar](MAX) NULL)

    INSERT INTO @TRN_DATCOC_DT 
	SELECT	Tbl.Col.value('(ProductDesc/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(500)') as ProductDesc,
			Tbl.Col.value('(GoldCode/text())[1]', 'VARCHAR(50)') as GoldCode,
			Tbl.Col.value('(TotalWeight/text())[1]', 'NUMERIC(19,8)') as TotalWeight,
			Tbl.Col.value('(DiamondWeight/text())[1]', 'NUMERIC(19,8)') as DiamondWeight,
			Tbl.Col.value('(GoldWeight/text())[1]', 'NUMERIC(19,8)') as GoldWeight,
			Tbl.Col.value('(TaskPrice/text())[1]', 'NUMERIC(18,3)') as TaskPrice,
			Tbl.Col.value('(Size/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') as Size,
			Tbl.Col.value('(SL/text())[1]', 'INT') as SL,
			Tbl.Col.value('(Notes/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') as Notes
	FROM @p_XML.nodes('//TRN_DATCOC_DT') as Tbl(Col)    

		INSERT INTO TRN_DATCOC_DT
           ([TrnID]
           ,[ProductDesc]
           ,[GoldCode]
           ,[TotalWeight]
           ,[DiamondWeight]
           ,[GoldWeight]
		   ,[TaskPrice]
           ,[Size]
           ,[SL]
           ,[Notes])
		SELECT
		   @m_TrnID
		   ,ProductDesc
		   ,DT.GoldCode
		   ,case when WeightUnit='L' then TotalWeight * @sHeSo ELSE TotalWeight END
           ,case when WeightUnit='L' then DiamondWeight *@sHeso ELSE DiamondWeight END
           ,case when WeightUnit='L' then GoldWeight *@sHeso ELSE GoldWeight END
           ,TaskPrice
           ,Size
		   ,SL
		   ,DT.Notes
		FROM @TRN_DATCOC_DT dt INNER JOIN I_GOLD IG ON DT.GoldCode = IG.GoldCode
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 GOTO ABORT

  COMMIT TRANSACTION
	SELECT 0 as ErrCode, '' ErrorDesc, @m_TrnID TrnID, 'W' Status, N'Chưa hoàn tất' StatusName,
	CASE WHEN @p_TrnDateTime_Upd IS NULL THEN Convert(varchar,GETDATE(),25) ELSE Convert(varchar,@p_TrnDateTime_Upd,25) END VersionDC
	RETURN 0
ABORT:
BEGIN
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
	SELECT -1 as ErrCode, @p_ErrorCode1 ErrorCode1, '' ErrorDesc, '' TrnID, '' Status, N'' StatusName,
	CASE WHEN @p_TrnDateTime_Upd IS NULL THEN Convert(varchar,GETDATE(),25) ELSE Convert(varchar,@p_TrnDateTime_Upd,25) END VersionDC
	RETURN -1
END

name: TRN_DATCOC_Upd
definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[TRN_DATCOC_Upd] 
@p_TrnID varchar(15),
@p_CustID varchar(15)=NULL,
@p_TienCoc varchar(100)=NULL,
@p_EmpID varchar(15)=NULL,
@p_Description nvarchar (500) = NULL,
@p_UserUpd Varchar(15),
@p_TrnDateTime_Upd DATETIME,

@p_XML XML

AS
	DECLARE @p_Message nvarchar(max)
	DECLARE @sBillCode nvarchar(20)
    DECLARE @p_ErrorCode1 nvarchar(max)
	SET @p_ErrorCode1 = ''
	SET @p_Message = ''

	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	DECLARE @sHeso NUMERIC(19,8) 
		
	SET @sHeso=dbo.fun_GetHS()

BEGIN TRANSACTION
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_DATCOC WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID)
	BEGIN
		SET @p_Message = (SELECT ErrorDesc FROM SYS_ERROR WHERE ErrorCode = 'B-001')
		SET @p_ErrorCode1 = 'B-001'
		GOTO ABORT
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_DATCOC WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID AND TrnDateTime_Upd <> @p_TrnDateTime_Upd)
	BEGIN
		select @p_Message = N'Dữ liệu của bạn đã được chỉnh sửa bởi ' + su.UserName + N' vào lúc ' 
		+ convert(varchar,crt.TrnDateTime_Upd,8) + N' ngày ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,crt.TrnDateTime_Upd,103)
		from SYS_USERS su inner join TRN_DATCOC crt on su.UserID = crt.UserID_Upd
		where crt.TrnID = @p_TrnID
		goto ABORT
	END
	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_DATCOC WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID and [Status]<>'W')
	BEGIN
		SET @p_Message = (SELECT ErrorDesc FROM SYS_ERROR WHERE ErrorCode = 'B-002')
		SET @p_ErrorCode1 = 'B-002'
		GOTO ABORT
	END
	set @p_TrnDateTime_Upd = getdate()

	UPDATE [TRN_DATCOC]
    SET [CustID] = CASE WHEN @p_CustID IS NOT NULL THEN @p_CustID ELSE [CustID] END,
        [TienCoc] = CASE WHEN @p_TienCoc IS NOT NULL THEN @p_TienCoc ELSE [TienCoc] END,
        [EmpID] = CASE WHEN @p_EmpID IS NOT NULL THEN @p_EmpID ELSE [EmpID] END,
        [Description] = CASE WHEN @p_Description IS NOT NULL THEN @p_Description ELSE [Description] END,
        [TrnDateTime_Upd] = @p_TrnDateTime_Upd,
        [UserID_Upd] = @p_UserUpd
	WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	--=========================================================================================================================================================
	DECLARE @TRN_DATCOC_DT TABLE(
	[TrnID] [varchar](15) NOT NULL,
	[ProductDesc] [nvarchar](500) NULL,
	[GoldCode] [varchar](10) NULL,
	[TotalWeight] [numeric](19, 8) NULL,
	[DiamondWeight] [numeric](19, 8) NULL,
	[GoldWeight] [numeric](19, 8) NULL,
	[TaskPrice] [numeric](18, 3) NULL,
	[Size] [NVARCHAR](MAX) NULL,
	[SL] [INT] NULL,
	[Notes] [nvarchar](MAX) NULL)

    INSERT INTO @TRN_DATCOC_DT 
	SELECT	Tbl.Col.value('(TrnID/text())[1]', 'VARCHAR(15)') as TrnID,
			Tbl.Col.value('(ProductDesc/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(500)') as ProductDesc,
			Tbl.Col.value('(GoldCode/text())[1]', 'VARCHAR(50)') as GoldCode,
			Tbl.Col.value('(TotalWeight/text())[1]', 'NUMERIC(19,8)') as TotalWeight,
			Tbl.Col.value('(DiamondWeight/text())[1]', 'NUMERIC(19,8)') as DiamondWeight,
			Tbl.Col.value('(GoldWeight/text())[1]', 'NUMERIC(19,8)') as GoldWeight,
			Tbl.Col.value('(TaskPrice/text())[1]', 'NUMERIC(18,3)') as TaskPrice,
			Tbl.Col.value('(Size/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') as Size,
			Tbl.Col.value('(SL/text())[1]', 'INT') as SL,
			Tbl.Col.value('(Notes/text())[1]', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') as Notes
	FROM @p_XML.nodes('//TRN_DATCOC_DT') as Tbl(Col)    
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	DELETE FROM TRN_DATCOC_DT WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

		INSERT INTO TRN_DATCOC_DT
           ([TrnID]
           ,[ProductDesc]
           ,[GoldCode]
           ,[TotalWeight]
           ,[DiamondWeight]
           ,[GoldWeight]
		   ,[TaskPrice]
           ,[Size]
           ,[SL]
           ,[Notes])
		SELECT
		   @p_TrnID
		   ,ProductDesc
		   ,DT.GoldCode
		   ,case when WeightUnit='L' then TotalWeight * @sHeSo ELSE TotalWeight END
           ,case when WeightUnit='L' then DiamondWeight *@sHeso ELSE DiamondWeight END
           ,case when WeightUnit='L' then GoldWeight *@sHeso ELSE GoldWeight END
           ,TaskPrice
           ,Size
		   ,SL
		   ,DT.Notes
		FROM @TRN_DATCOC_DT dt INNER JOIN I_GOLD IG ON DT.GoldCode = IG.GoldCode
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 GOTO ABORT

  COMMIT TRANSACTION
	SELECT 0 as ErrCode, '' ErrorDesc, @p_TrnID TrnID, 'W' Status, N'Lưu tạm' StatusName,
	CASE WHEN @p_TrnDateTime_Upd IS NULL THEN Convert(varchar,GETDATE(),25) ELSE Convert(varchar,@p_TrnDateTime_Upd,25) END VersionDC
	RETURN 0
ABORT:
BEGIN
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
	SELECT -1 as ErrCode, @p_ErrorCode1 ErrorCode1, @p_Message ErrorDesc, '' TrnID, '' Status, N'' StatusName,
	CASE WHEN @p_TrnDateTime_Upd IS NULL THEN Convert(varchar,GETDATE(),25) ELSE Convert(varchar,@p_TrnDateTime_Upd,25) END VersionDC
	RETURN -1
END

name: TRN_DATCOC_Get
definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[TRN_DATCOC_Get] 
	@p_TrnID varchar(15)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @sHeso NUMERIC(19,8) 
		
	SET @sHeso=dbo.fun_GetHS()

	select [TrnID]
      ,[BillCode]
      ,TrnDate
      ,[TrnTime]
      ,DC.[CustID]
      ,[TienCoc]
      ,[EmpID]
      ,[Description]
      ,case when [CardPay] > 0 then [CashPay] else [TienCoc] end CashPay
      ,isnull([CardPay],0) CardPay
      ,[Status]
      ,case [Status] when 'W' then N'Lưu tạm' when 'P' then N'Đã thanh toán' else N'Hoàn tất' end StatusName
      ,[ShopID]
      ,[CreatedBy]
      ,Convert(varchar,[TrnDateTime_Upd],25) TrnDateTime_Upd
      ,[UserID_Upd] 
	from TRN_DATCOC DC
	LEFT JOIN I_CUSTOMER C ON DC.CustID = C.CustID
	where TrnID = @p_TrnID

	select [TrnDTID]
      ,[TrnID]
      ,[ProductDesc]
      ,DT.[GoldCode]
      ,case when IG.WeightUnit ='L' then [TotalWeight]/@sHeso else [TotalWeight] end TotalWeight
      ,case when IG.WeightUnit ='L' then [DiamondWeight]/@sHeso else [DiamondWeight] end DiamondWeight
      ,case when IG.WeightUnit ='L' then [GoldWeight]/@sHeso else [GoldWeight] end GoldWeight
      ,[TaskPrice]
      ,[Size]
      ,[SL]
      ,DT.[Notes]
	from TRN_DATCOC_DT DT
	LEFT JOIN I_GOLD IG ON IG.GoldCode = DT.GoldCode
	where TrnID = @p_TrnID

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[TRN_DATCOC_Lst] 
	@p_FDate varchar(10) = '',
	@p_TDate varchar(10) = '',
	@p_CustID varchar(15) = '',
	@p_BillCode varchar(50) = '',
	@p_UserID varchar(15) = '',
	@p_ShopID varchar(15) = '',
	@p_Status varchar (1) = ''

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @sHeso NUMERIC(19,8) 
		
	SET @sHeso=dbo.fun_GetHS()

declare @fdate datetime
if(@p_FDate is not null and @p_FDate <> '')
begin
set @fdate = convert(datetime, @p_FDate, 103)
end

declare @tdate datetime
if(@p_TDate is not null and @p_FDate <> '')
begin
set @tdate = convert(datetime, @p_TDate, 103)
end

	select [TrnID]
      ,[BillCode]
      ,TrnDate
      ,[TrnTime]
      ,DC.[CustID]
	  ,C.CustName
      ,[TienCoc]
      ,DC.[EmpID]
	  ,E.EmpName
      ,[Description]
      ,case when [CardPay] > 0 then [CashPay] else [TienCoc] end CashPay
      ,[CardPay]
      ,[Status]
      ,case [Status] when 'W' then N'Lưu tạm' when 'P' then N'Đã thanh toán' else N'Hoàn tất' end StatusName
      ,DC.[ShopID]
	  ,TS.ShopName
      ,[CreatedBy]
	  ,us.UserName
	  ,C.Phone
	from TRN_DATCOC DC
	LEFT JOIN I_CUSTOMER C ON DC.CustID = C.CustID
	left join T_EMPLOYEE E on E.EmpID = DC.EmpID
	left join T_SHOP TS on TS.ShopID = DC.ShopID
	left join SYS_USERS us on us.UserID = DC.[CreatedBy]
	where (@p_FDate = '' or TrnDate >= @fdate)
	and (@p_TDate = '' or TrnDate <= @tdate)
	and ( @p_CustID = '' or DC.CustID = @p_CustID)
	and (@p_BillCode = '' or DC.BillCode = @p_BillCode)
	and (@p_UserID = '' or DC.CreatedBy = @p_UserID)
	and (@p_ShopID = '' or DC.ShopID = @p_ShopID)
	and (@p_Status = '' or DC.Status = @p_Status)
END

name: TRN_DATCOC_Complete
definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[TRN_DATCOC_Complete]
	@p_TrnID VARCHAR(15),
	@p_UserID VARCHAR(15)
AS
	DECLARE @sErr nvarchar(30), @sErrCode varchar(100), @p_ErrorCode1 nvarchar(MAX)
	DECLARE @sTillTxnID varchar(15)
	DECLARE @sBillCode nvarchar(20)
SET XACT_ABORT ON;

BEGIN TRANSACTION
    DECLARE @MaTienTeHeThong Varchar(10)    
    SELECT @MaTienTeHeThong = ParaValue From SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'MaTienTeHeThong'
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_DATCOC WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID )
	BEGIN
		SET @sErr = (SELECT ErrorDesc FROM SYS_ERROR WHERE ErrorCode = 'B-001')
		SET @p_ErrorCode1 = 'B-001'
		GOTO ABORT
	END
	
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_DATCOC WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID and [Status]<>'W')
	BEGIN
		SET @sErr = (SELECT ErrorDesc FROM SYS_ERROR WHERE ErrorCode = 'B-002')
		SET @p_ErrorCode1 = 'B-002'
		GOTO ABORT
	END
		
	DECLARE @sCustID VARCHAR(20)
	SELECT @sCustID = s.CustID
	FROM TRN_DATCOC s WHERE s.TrnID = @p_TrnID

	------ UPDATE Status --------
	-- Cập nhật lại billcode nếu para TaoMaHDParam = true
	  	
	DECLARE @sShopCode varchar(max)
	select @sShopCode = ISNULL(TS.ShopCode,'') 
	From T_Shop TS INNER JOIN TRN_DATCOC PM ON TS.ShopID = PM.ShopID 
	Where PM.TrnID = @p_TrnID
    
	DECLARE @TaoMaHDParam int
	SET @TaoMaHDParam = (SELECT ParaValue FROM SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'TaoSoHDKhiThanhToan')
	IF (@TaoMaHDParam = 1)
		BEGIN
			EXEC SYS_BILL_COUNTER_Gen 'TDC', @sShopCode, @sBillCode OUTPUT
			UPDATE TRN_DATCOC SET BillCode = @sBillCode, Status='P' WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
		END
	ELSE
		UPDATE TRN_DATCOC SET Status='P' WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
		
	SET @sBillCode = (SELECT BillCode FROM TRN_DATCOC WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID)
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	------ Insert TILL TXN -------------
	EXEC TRN_TILL_TXN_Ins
		@p_TrnID = @p_TrnID,
		@p_TrnType = 'TDC',
		@p_TrnCode = 'TDC',
		@p_ErrCOde = @sErrCode OUT
		SET @sErr = (SELECT se.ErrorDesc
		               FROM SYS_ERROR se WHERE se.ErrorCode = @sErrCode)
	IF @sErrCode <> '0' GOTO ABORT
	----- Sau khi insert vao giao dich till, Lay lai TillTxnID
	SELECT @sTillTxnID = TillTxnID
	FROM T_TILL_TXN
	WHERE TrnRefID = @p_TrnID
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

declare @NgayGiaoDich DATETIME
SET @NgayGiaoDich =  CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),GetDate(),103),103)

UPDATE I_CUSTOMER SET
LastTradingDate = @NgayGiaoDich where CustID = @sCustID

COMMIT TRANSACTION

SELECT 0 AS ErrCode, @p_TrnID TrnID, @sTillTxnID TillTxnID, @sBillCode BillCode, '' ErrorDesc
RETURN 0
ABORT:

BEGIN
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
SELECT -1 AS ErrCode, @p_ErrorCode1 ErrorCode1, '' TrnID, '' TillTxnID, @sErr ErrorDesc, @sBillCode BillCode
RETURN -1
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[TRN_DATCOC_Del]
	@p_TrnID VARCHAR(15),
	@p_UserUpd varchar(15),
	@p_TrnDateTime_Upd DATETIME
AS
SET XACT_ABORT ON;
BEGIN TRANSACTION
	DECLARE @p_Message nvarchar(max)
	SET @p_Message = ''
	DECLARE @p_ErrorCode1 nvarchar(max)
	SET @p_ErrorCode1 = ''

	-- kiểm tra version
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_DATCOC WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID AND TrnDateTime_Upd <> @p_TrnDateTime_Upd)
	BEGIN
		select @p_Message = N'Dữ liệu của bạn đã được chỉnh sửa bởi ' + su.UserName + N' vào lúc ' 
		+ convert(varchar,crt.TrnDateTime_Upd,8) + N' ngày ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,crt.TrnDateTime_Upd,103)
		from SYS_USERS su inner join TRN_RT_BUYSELL crt on su.UserID = crt.UserID_Upd
		where crt.TrnID = @p_TrnID
		goto ABORT
	END
	
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_DATCOC WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID)
	BEGIN
		SET @p_Message = (SELECT ErrorDesc FROM SYS_ERROR WHERE ErrorCode = 'B-001')
		SET @p_ErrorCode1 ='B-001'
		GOTO ABORT
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_DATCOC WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID and [Status]<>'W')
	BEGIN
		SET @p_Message = (SELECT ErrorDesc FROM SYS_ERROR WHERE ErrorCode = 'B-002')
		SET @p_ErrorCode1 ='B-002'
		GOTO ABORT
	END	
	
	DELETE TRN_DATCOC_DT WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	DELETE TRN_DATCOC WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

COMMIT TRANSACTION
	SELECT 0 as Result, '' ErrorDesc, ''
	RETURN 0
ABORT:
BEGIN
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
	SELECT -1 as Result, @p_Message ErrorDesc, @p_ErrorCode1 ErrorCode1
	RETURN -1
END

name: TRN_DATCOC_QryList

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[TRN_DATCOC_QryList] 
	@p_FDate varchar(10) = '',
	@p_TDate varchar(10) = '',
	@p_CustID varchar(15) = '',
	@p_EmpID varchar(15) = '',
	@p_status varchar(1) = '',
	@p_UserID varchar(15) = '',
	@p_ShopID varchar(15) = ''

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @sHeso NUMERIC(19,8) 
		
	SET @sHeso=dbo.fun_GetHS()

declare @fdate datetime
if(@p_FDate is not null and @p_FDate <> '')
begin
set @fdate = convert(datetime, @p_FDate, 103)
end

declare @tdate datetime
if(@p_TDate is not null and @p_FDate <> '')
begin
set @tdate = convert(datetime, @p_TDate, 103)
end

	select [TrnID]
      ,[BillCode]
      ,TrnDate
      ,[TrnTime]
      ,DC.[CustID]
	  ,C.CustName
      ,[TienCoc]
      ,DC.[EmpID]
	  ,E.EmpName
      ,[Description]
      ,case when [CardPay] = 0 then [TienCoc] else [CashPay] end CashPay
      ,[CardPay]
      ,[Status]
      ,case [Status] when 'W' then N'Lưu tạm' when 'P' then N'Đã thanh toán' else N'Hoàn tất' end StatusName
      ,DC.[ShopID]
	  ,TS.ShopName
      ,[CreatedBy]
	  ,us.UserName
	  ,c.Phone
	from TRN_DATCOC DC
	LEFT JOIN I_CUSTOMER C ON DC.CustID = C.CustID
	left join T_EMPLOYEE E on E.EmpID = DC.EmpID
	left join T_SHOP TS on TS.ShopID = DC.ShopID
	left join SYS_USERS us on us.UserID = DC.[CreatedBy]
	where (@p_FDate = '' or TrnDate >= @fdate)
	and (@p_TDate = '' or TrnDate <= @tdate)
	and ( @p_status = '' or DC.Status = @p_status)
	and ( @p_CustID = '' or DC.CustID = @p_CustID)
	and (@p_EmpID = '' or DC.EmpID = @p_EmpID)
	and (@p_UserID = '' or DC.CreatedBy = @p_UserID)
	and (@p_ShopID = '' or DC.ShopID = @p_ShopID)
END
